group.name: reactions
group.title: Reactions Settings
group.description: Configure the reaction system with Facebook-style advanced options

settings.name: reactions_enabled
settings.title: Enable Reactions
settings.description: Globally enable or disable the reaction system.

settings.name: reactions_min_posts
settings.title: Minimum Posts to React
settings.description: Users must have at least this many posts to be able to give reactions. Super User Groups bypass this restriction.

settings.name: reactions_min_reputation
settings.title: Minimum Reputation to React
settings.description: Users must have at least this much reputation to be able to give reactions. Super User Groups bypass this restriction.

settings.name: reactions_self_react
settings.title: Allow Self-Reactions
settings.description: Allow users to react to their own posts. Note: Super User Groups can always react to their own posts regardless of this setting.

settings.name: reactions_closed_threads
settings.title: Allow Reactions in Closed Threads
settings.description: Allow users to react to posts in closed/locked threads. Super user groups bypass this restriction.

settings.name: reactions_edit_time_limit
settings.title: Reaction Time Limit (Minutes)
settings.description: Time in minutes a user has to change or remove their reaction. Set to 0 for unlimited. Super User Groups bypass this restriction.

settings.name: reactions_display_postbit
settings.title: Show Scores in Postbit
settings.description: Display total reaction scores in the post author information area.

settings.name: reactions_display_profile
settings.title: Show Stats in Profile
settings.description: Display reaction statistics and history on user profiles.

settings.name: reactions_user_notification_prefs
settings.title: Allow User Notification Preferences
settings.description: If enabled, users will see notification preference options in their UserCP to control which reaction notifications they receive. If disabled, all users will receive all reaction notifications.

settings.name: reactions_flood_time
settings.title: Reaction Flood Check
settings.description: Minimum time in seconds between giving reactions. Set to 0 to disable.

settings.name: reactions_excluded_forums
settings.title: Excluded Forums
settings.description: Comma-separated list of forum IDs where reactions should be disabled.

settings.name: reactions_integrate_myalerts
settings.title: Integrate with MyAlerts
settings.description: Send MyAlerts notifications when someone reacts to a user's post. Requires the MyAlerts plugin to be installed and activated.

settings.name: reactions_integrate_reputation
settings.title: Integrate with Reputation
settings.description: If enabled, reaction scores will be added to the user's total reputation score.

settings.name: reactions_reputation_allow_negative
settings.title: Allow Negative Reactions in Reputation
settings.description: If enabled, negative reaction scores (e.g., Angry = -1) will subtract from the user's reputation. If disabled, only positive and neutral reactions will count towards reputation.

settings.name: reactions_gift_reputation
settings.title: Convert Gifted Reactions to Reputation
settings.description: If enabled, reaction points given by administrators via the 'Give Reaction Points' tool will also be added to the user's reputation. If disabled, only regular post reactions will count towards reputation.

settings.name: reactions_view_groups
settings.title: User Groups Can View Reactions
settings.description: Select which user groups can view the reaction bar and statistics. Select 'All groups' to allow everyone, or leave empty to deny all.

settings.name: reactions_use_groups_list
settings.title: User Groups not Allowed to React
settings.description: Select user groups that CANNOT give reactions. Guests (GID 1) and Banned (GID 7) are blocked by default. Select 'None' to allow all groups, or 'All groups' to block everyone.

settings.name: reactions_receive_groups
settings.title: User Groups not Allowed to Receive Reactions
settings.description: Select user groups that CANNOT receive reactions. Guests (GID 1) and Banned (GID 7) are blocked by default. Select 'None' to allow all groups, or 'All groups' to block everyone.

settings.name: reactions_remove_groups_list
settings.title: User Groups Allowed to Remove
settings.description: Select which user groups can remove reactions. Select 'All groups' to allow everyone, or leave empty to deny all.

settings.name: reactions_super_groups
settings.title: Super User Groups
settings.description: Select user groups that have super privileges for reactions. These groups bypass all restrictions including: daily limits, minimum posts/reputation requirements, excluded forums, closed threads, self-reaction restrictions, and time limits for editing/removing reactions.
